_comment: Curated descriptions for the solve.js CLI subcommands. Consumed by scripts/gen-solve-commands-index.js (run via `npm run steering:generate`) to emit docs/steering/generated/solve-commands.md. Keys MUST match the COMMANDS map in scripts/solve.js: a registered command missing here renders as `(undocumented)` and a key here that is not registered renders under `Documented but not registered`, so `npm run steering:check` fails on either drift. Add or correct entries here, not in the generated markdown.

start.summary: Seal a quest: validate solve/quests/<id>/quest.json and its epic, measure the doneWhen probe, refuse unless the probe is red, then record sealedAt (HEAD) and the seal-time metric in the log.

note.summary: Append one log entry: a finding (kinds theory, altitude-check, decision, ruled-out, evidence), an attempt (records HEAD and the changed paths), a verification (verifier subagent:<id>, verdict approve|reject), or a terminal entry other than solved (blocked with a next owner, exhausted, superseded).
note.usage: node scripts/solve.js note --id <quest> (--finding "<text>" [--kind <kind>] [--status <status>] [--evidence <ref>] | --attempt "<what changed>" | --verification "<summary>" --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve|reject | --blocked "<why>" --next-owner judgment|verification|authorization | --exhausted "<why>" | --superseded "<why>" [--by <quest>]) [--json]

probe.summary: Measure a quest's doneWhen (or an epic's with --epic): metric, target, done, whether it measured, the delta from the seal-time value, and the last three log entries.

land.summary: Land a sealed quest: the probe must be green; a standing rejection blocks; src/ changes need a current approving verification; the altitude budget, the epic's authorizes scope, the coupled-pair guard and the changed-path static checkers must pass; then the inventories refresh, the canonical import graph verifies, npm test runs, the change commits with LAGRANGE_SOLVER_LANDING=1, and a terminal solved entry is written. Never pushes.

evidence.summary: Upload a file to the solve-evidence pre-release, verify it by re-download and re-hash, and record an evidence finding with the sha256 reference and URL; nothing is recorded on a mismatch.

board.summary: Print the open epics and open quests computed from solve/epics and solve/quests on demand; nothing is written.
